name: Leadfeeder
summary: Website visitor identification for B2B sales. See which companies visit your site and what they viewed, and turn anonymous traffic into a warm pipeline.
best_for: B2B teams with real website traffic and a sales team that will actually work the list — the free tier is enough to find out whether your traffic contains anyone worth calling
skip_if: your traffic is mostly consumer or very low volume, because company identification needs business networks to match against and thin traffic produces a thin list
honest_knock: The words doing the work are 'starting at'. What actually sets your price is how many companies you identify a month, and the page shows that allowance as 'Tiered' with no figures at any level. So €79 is the floor of the smallest bucket, and you cannot tell from the page which bucket your traffic puts you in. Get that table before you talk price. Two other things: month-to-month costs 43% more than annual on the same plan (€113 against €79), and Scale is annual-only, so the tier most growing teams land on cannot be tried for a month.

pricing.notes: (read 2026-08-26 on leadfeeder.com/pricing over a US connection) Lite is free forever with a 14-day full trial, seven days of visitor history and the last 100 companies a month. Discover starts at $79 a month, Activate at $369 and Scale at $599, all billed annually, which the page marks as 30% off. Worth knowing: the page carries both currencies with the same figures — $79 for an American is €79 for a European, not a converted amount — so the euro price is the more expensive of the two.

free_plan_evidence: (read 2026-08-26 on leadfeeder.com/pricing over a US connection) Lite is free forever with a 14-day full trial, seven days of visitor history and the last 100 companies a month.

compare_with.name: Albacross or Clearbit
compare_with.why: the direct visitor-identification peers — compare the identified-company allowance at your traffic level, since that is the number that sets the bill
